summary: Jaden McDaniels scored 34 points as Minnesota beat Brooklyn by 26, the night's widest margin, while Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's 38 points were not enough for Oklahoma City in a 125-120 loss at Indiana. Phoenix beat New Orleans 123-119 in the night's only overtime game, and Milwaukee won at Toronto after 15 lead changes. San Antonio beat Sacramento by 16 without Victor Wembanyama.

games.headline: Ty Jerome hits seven threes as Grizzlies top Hornets
games.story: The game was tied nine times before Memphis used a 10-0 run in the third quarter to go ahead 79-72, and the Grizzlies never trailed again. The Grizzlies led by 12 in the fourth and made all 24 of their free throws. Ty Jerome scored 29 points with seven threes, and Cam Spencer added 24 on 11-of-11 free throws. Christian Anderson led Charlotte with 25 points, Naz Reid scored 24 on 8-of-25 shooting, and the Hornets were without Kon Knueppel and Grayson Allen.

games.headline: Avdija scores 31 as Trail Blazers pull away from 76ers
games.story: The game was tied 69-69 at halftime and 11 times in all before Portland went ahead for good at 82-80 midway through the third quarter. The Trail Blazers built a 22-point lead in the fourth. Deni Avdija scored 31 points with seven assists, Donovan Clingan had 15 points and 18 rebounds, and Portland made 19 threes to Philadelphia's nine. LeBron James led the 76ers with 23 points, and they were without Joel Embiid.

games.headline: Pacers hold off Gilgeous-Alexander's 38 to beat Thunder
games.story: Indiana led by 13 early in the third quarter, and the game was tied 98-98 with 9:19 left before the Pacers went ahead for good. Oklahoma City pulled within one point twice in the final 1:33 but never regained the lead. Kelly Oubre Jr. and Pascal Siakam scored 20 points each, Ivica Zubac had 15 rebounds, and Indiana won the rebounding battle 58-49. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 38 points for the Thunder, who were without Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren.

games.headline: Herro and Turner lead Bucks past Raptors late
games.story: The lead changed hands 15 times, and the last tie came at 98-98 with 5:15 left. Milwaukee went ahead for good 18 seconds later and led by 10 with just over a minute to play. Tyler Herro scored 32 points with eight assists, and Myles Turner had 27 points, 11 rebounds and four blocks while making five of six threes. Scottie Barnes led Toronto with 31 points and eight assists, and the Raptors were without Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett.

games.headline: Jaden McDaniels scores 34 as Timberwolves rout Nets
games.story: Minnesota led from the opening minutes and scored 41 points in both the first and third quarters to go up 115-91 after three. The lead reached 30 early in the fourth quarter, and Brooklyn finished with 21 turnovers. Jaden McDaniels scored 34 points on 12-of-16 shooting with 10 rebounds, and Ayo Dosunmu added 23. Julius Randle led the Nets with 29 points, and the Timberwolves were without Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo.

games.headline: Bulls' 45-point second quarter sinks Cavaliers
games.story: Chicago outscored Cleveland 45-20 in the second quarter and led 72-48 late in the half. The Cavaliers scored 11 straight points around halftime and trailed only 93-89 after three, but the Bulls answered with a 10-0 run in the fourth to go up 113-97. Jordan Hawkins scored 19 points, Tre Jones had 16 points and nine assists, and Chicago made 20 threes. Donovan Mitchell led Cleveland with 28 points, James Harden had 21 with seven turnovers, and the Cavaliers were without Evan Mobley.

games.headline: Suns outlast Pelicans in overtime
games.story: The lead changed hands 19 times, and New Orleans tied the game 109-109 with 22 seconds left in regulation. Phoenix went ahead for good at 113-111 with 3:49 left in overtime and won the extra period 14-10. Jalen Green scored 25 points and Devin Booker had 22 points and eight assists. Jordan Poole led the Pelicans with 28 points and six threes, Zion Williamson added 25, and New Orleans was without Dejounte Murray.

games.headline: Durant scores 32 as Rockets pull away from Clippers
games.story: The Clippers used a 12-0 run early in the third quarter to take a 55-51 lead. Houston went ahead for good at 67-65 midway through the quarter and won the third 38-32. Kevin Durant scored 32 points on 11-of-19 shooting with nine rebounds, Amen Thompson added 20 on 9-of-12, and Alperen Sengun had 20 points, eight rebounds and seven assists. Darius Garland led the Clippers with 26 points and eight assists, and they were without Bradley Beal.

games.headline: Lakers pull away from Jazz with 11-0 run
games.story: Utah led 77-76 late in the third quarter before the Lakers scored 11 straight points across the break to go up 87-77. Los Angeles won the fourth quarter 31-17 and led by as many as 17. Luka Dončić scored 28 points with eight assists, and Jake LaRavia added 15 points and 10 rebounds. Kyle Filipowski led the Jazz with 21 points and 12 rebounds, Utah made six of 32 threes, and the Jazz were without Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr.

games.headline: Spurs erase early deficit to beat Kings
games.story: Sacramento led 28-16 late in the first quarter, and San Antonio won the second quarter 41-23 to lead 60-51 at halftime. A 12-0 run in the third quarter pushed the Spurs' lead to 77-59, and it reached 22 later in the period. Stephon Castle had 28 points and 11 assists, Julian Champagnie made six threes for 22 points, and Luke Kornet had 18 points and 11 rebounds. Domantas Sabonis led the Kings with 20 points and 12 rebounds, and the Spurs were without Victor Wembanyama and De'Aaron Fox.
